hints.title: Obstacle Set Hashing
hints.text: Store obstacle coordinates in a lookup collection to verify whether any step is blocked.

hints.title: Directional Heading Cycler
hints.text: Represent direction as an index 0 to 3 for North, East, South, West. Left turn is (dir + 3) % 4 and right turn is (dir + 1) % 4.

hints.title: Step by Step Collision Handling
hints.text: Advance one unit at a time. If the next coordinate collides with an obstacle, abort the remaining units of that command and preserve the max Euclidean norm.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: C: total step count across commands
complexity.notes: Constant-time obstacle collision checks per step taken.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear array searching for obstacles at each step takes O(C * K) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set of obstacle coordinate pairs requires O(K) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use modulo arithmetic for directions and hash set for obstacle lookups.
